faq.title: Siding Questions?
faq.subtitle: Common questions Dallas homeowners ask about siding installation, repair, costs, and storm damage claims.

items.question: How much does siding installation cost in Dallas, TX?
items.answer: Siding installation costs in Dallas typically range from $7 to $20 per square foot installed, depending on the material. Vinyl siding averages $8–$12/sq ft, while fiber cement (James Hardie) runs $10–$16/sq ft. A typical 1,500–2,000 sq ft Dallas home can expect to pay between $12,000 and $30,000 for a full installation. We provide free, detailed written estimates so you know exactly what to expect before any work begins.

items.question: How long does siding installation take in Dallas?
items.answer: Most residential siding projects in Dallas take between 1 and 5 days, depending on the size of the home, the number of stories, material choice, and weather conditions. Our crew works efficiently without sacrificing quality. We provide a specific project timeline in your written estimate so you can plan accordingly.

items.question: What is the best siding material for Dallas, Texas homes?
items.answer: For the Dallas climate — hot summers, high UV exposure, and periodic severe storms — we most commonly recommend fiber cement siding (particularly James Hardie products) and premium vinyl siding. Fiber cement is exceptionally durable, fire-resistant, and handles Texas heat with no warping or fading. Vinyl offers great value and zero maintenance. We'll discuss which material best suits your home, budget, and aesthetic goals during your free consultation.

items.question: Do you offer siding repair services or only full replacement?
items.answer: We offer both! Many siding problems — including cracked panels, rotting boards, impact damage, and localized storm damage — can be resolved with targeted repairs at a fraction of replacement cost. During our free inspection, we assess the extent of the damage and provide honest recommendations. We'll never push you toward a full replacement if repairs are the smarter solution for your situation.

items.question: What is vinyl siding and how long does it last?
items.answer: Vinyl siding is a popular exterior cladding made from PVC (polyvinyl chloride) that comes in dozens of colors, textures, and profiles. It's known for being low-maintenance (never needs painting), affordable, and durable. Quality vinyl siding installed by licensed contractors in Dallas can last 30–50 years. It's also a great insulator, helping reduce energy bills — an important consideration in North Texas summers.

items.question: What is fiber cement siding and how is it different from vinyl?
items.answer: Fiber cement siding is manufactured from cement, sand, and cellulose fibers, creating an extremely durable composite material. Compared to vinyl, fiber cement is heavier, more rigid, and offers superior resistance to fire, insects, moisture, and impact damage from hail — making it ideal for Dallas homeowners. It also accepts paint and can mimic the look of wood grain beautifully. James Hardie is the industry leader, and we're a certified Preferred Contractor.

items.question: My home suffered hail damage. How do I know if I should file an insurance claim?
items.answer: After any significant hail event in the Dallas area, we strongly recommend requesting a free inspection from a licensed contractor before contacting your insurance company. We can document the damage thoroughly with photos and measurements, assess whether it crosses the threshold for a claim, and provide a professional damage report. Filing an unwarranted claim can raise your premiums; not filing a legitimate claim leaves you paying out of pocket. We help you make the right call.

items.question: Do you work with homeowner's insurance for storm damage siding repair?
items.answer: Yes — we work with insurance claims regularly and have extensive experience navigating the process for Dallas homeowners. We document damage professionally, provide detailed estimates that meet insurance company requirements, and can communicate directly with your adjuster if needed. Our goal is to help you get the maximum coverage you're entitled to under your policy, with minimal stress on your end.

items.question: How long does fiber cement (James Hardie) siding last in Texas?
items.answer: James Hardie fiber cement siding is backed by a 30-year non-prorated manufacturer warranty and, with proper installation and maintenance, can last 50+ years in the Texas climate. Unlike wood, it won't rot, warp, or swell from moisture. Unlike vinyl, it won't melt or distort under extreme heat. When installed by a Preferred Contractor like Dallas Siding Experts, you also receive the extended warranty.

items.question: Do you offer financing options for siding installation?
items.answer: Yes, we partner with financing providers to offer flexible payment plans that fit your budget. Many Dallas homeowners find this helpful for larger full-replacement projects. During your free estimate appointment, ask your project manager about current financing options, interest rates, and payment terms. We believe every homeowner deserves quality siding regardless of their budget situation.
